Name: Tired Sebastian reskin
Author: Hughskadoo
Description:
Part of a passion project involving reskinning the townspeople to be duller yet more interesting in terms of appearance, Sebastian was inevitable to be altered.

With new red hair, stretched ears, lip piercing and a sick tattoo, this Sebastian takes on a punk-ish style with a quieter/duller colour palette. Perfect for the Sebastian fan looking for a sicker style in their lil depressed guy.

This mod only alters portraits and sprites for the Sebastian character, I hope to one day release a mod that'll have him talk in a manner befitting his new look, but this will do for now.

I hope you enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Replaces default Sebastian with a duller, yet punk-ish version.
